TCPSocket: A TCP socket, exposed as a duplex stream.
TCPSocket.connecting: Whether the socket is currently connecting.
TCPSocket.pending: Whether the socket has not yet connected.
TCPSocket.timeout: The timeout in milliseconds, or `undefined` if no timeout is set.
TCPSocket.readyState: The current state of the socket. Either `'open'` or `'opening'`.
TCPSocket.localAddress: The local IP address of the socket, if connected.
TCPSocket.localFamily: The local IP family (`'IPv4'` or `'IPv6'`), if connected.
TCPSocket.localPort: The local port of the socket, if connected.
TCPSocket.remoteAddress: The remote IP address of the socket, if connected.
TCPSocket.remoteFamily: The remote IP family (`'IPv4'` or `'IPv6'`), if connected.
TCPSocket.remotePort: The remote port of the socket, if connected.
TCPSocket.connect: Connect the socket to `port` on `host`. If `host` is not provided, it defaults to `'localhost'`. `onconnect` is called when the connection is established.
TCPSocket.open: Open the socket on the file descriptor of an existing TCP connection, emitting `'connect'` once open.
TCPSocket.setKeepAlive: Enable or disable keep-alive. `delay` is the initial delay in milliseconds before the first keep-alive probe is sent.
TCPSocket.setNoDelay: Enable or disable Nagle's algorithm. When `enable` is `true` (the default), data is sent immediately without buffering.
TCPSocket.setTimeout: Set a timeout in milliseconds. When the socket is idle for `ms` milliseconds, a `timeout` event is emitted. Pass `0` to disable the timeout.
TCPSocket.ref: Ref the socket, preventing the process from exiting.
TCPSocket.unref: Unref the socket, allowing the process to exit.
TCPServer: A TCP server; extends `EventEmitter`, emitting each accepted socket as a `'connection'` event.
TCPServer.constructor: Create a new TCP server. If `onconnection` is provided, it is added as a listener for the `connection` event.
TCPServer.maxConnections: The maximum number of concurrent connections; connections beyond it are destroyed and reported via the `'drop'` event. Defaults to `Infinity`.
TCPServer.listen: Start listening for connections on `port` and `host`. If `port` is `0`, an available port is assigned. If `host` is not provided, it defaults to `'localhost'`. `backlog` defaults to `511`.
TCPServer.close: Close the server. No new connections will be accepted. The server emits `close` after all existing connections have ended.
TCPServer.ref: Ref the server, preventing the process from exiting.
TCPServer.unref: Unref the server, allowing the process to exit.
createConnection: Create a new socket and connect it to `port` on `host`. Shorthand for `new tcp.Socket(options).connect(port, host, options, onconnect)`.
createServer: Create a new TCP server. `server` extends <https://github.com/holepunchto/bare-events>.
socketpair: Create a pair of connected sockets, returning their file descriptors.
isIP: Returns `4` if `host` is an IPv4 address, `6` if it is an IPv6 address, or `0` otherwise.
isIPv4: Returns `true` if `host` is an IPv4 address.
isIPv6: Returns `true` if `host` is an IPv6 address.
TCPSocketAddress: The address of a TCP socket, as `{ address, family, port }`.
TCPSocketEvents.lookup: Emitted after resolving the hostname. The arguments are `err`, `address`, `family`, and `host`.
TCPSocketEvents.timeout: Emitted when the socket times out due to inactivity.
TCPSocketOptions.readBufferSize: Size, in bytes, of the socket's internal read buffer. Defaults to `65536`.
TCPSocketOptions.allowHalfOpen: Keep the writable side of the socket open after the readable side ends. Defaults to `true`.
TCPSocketOptions.eagerOpen: Open the socket immediately instead of waiting for the first write. Defaults to `true`.
TCPSocketConnectOptions.host: The host to connect to. Defaults to `'localhost'`.
TCPSocketConnectOptions.lookup: The function used to resolve hostnames. Defaults to `dns.lookup` from `bare-dns`.
TCPSocketConnectOptions.keepAlive: Enable keep-alive on the socket once connected. Defaults to `false`.
TCPSocketConnectOptions.keepAliveInitial: The initial delay in milliseconds before the first keep-alive probe is sent. Defaults to `0`.
TCPSocketConnectOptions.noDelay: Send data immediately without buffering, disabling Nagle's algorithm. Defaults to `false`.
TCPSocketConnectOptions.timeout: An inactivity timeout in milliseconds, set on the socket once connected.
TCPServerDropInfo: Details of a connection dropped because `maxConnections` was exceeded.
TCPServerDropInfo.localAddress: The local IP address of the dropped connection.
TCPServerDropInfo.localFamily: The local IP family of the dropped connection.
TCPServerDropInfo.localPort: The local port of the dropped connection.
TCPServerDropInfo.remoteAddress: The remote IP address of the dropped connection.
TCPServerDropInfo.remoteFamily: The remote IP family of the dropped connection.
TCPServerDropInfo.remotePort: The remote port of the dropped connection.
TCPServerEvents.listening: Emitted when the server starts listening.
TCPServerEvents.connection: Emitted when a new connection is received. The argument is a `TCPSocket`.
TCPServerEvents.drop: Emitted when an incoming connection is dropped because `maxConnections` was exceeded, with details of the dropped connection.
TCPServerEvents.lookup: Emitted after resolving the hostname. The arguments are `err`, `address`, `family`, and `host`.
TCPServerOptions: Options for a TCP server, applied to each incoming socket.
TCPServerOptions.readBufferSize: Size, in bytes, of each incoming socket's read buffer. Defaults to `65536`.
TCPServerOptions.allowHalfOpen: Keep the writable side of each incoming socket open after the readable side ends. Defaults to `true`.
TCPServerOptions.keepAlive: Enable keep-alive on each incoming socket. Defaults to `false`.
TCPServerOptions.keepAliveInitialDelay: The initial delay in milliseconds before the first keep-alive probe is sent. Defaults to `0`.
TCPServerOptions.noDelay: Send data immediately without buffering, disabling Nagle's algorithm, on each incoming socket. Defaults to `false`.
TCPServerOptions.pauseOnConnect: Pause each incoming socket on connection instead of opening it eagerly. Defaults to `false`.
TCPServerOptions.maxConnections: The maximum number of concurrent connections; connections beyond it are dropped. Defaults to `Infinity`.
TCPServerListenOptions.port: The port to listen on; if `0`, an available port is assigned. Defaults to `0`.
TCPServerListenOptions.host: The host to listen on. Defaults to `'localhost'`.
TCPServerListenOptions.backlog: The maximum length of the queue of pending connections. Defaults to `511`.
TCPServerListenOptions.lookup: The function used to resolve hostnames. Defaults to `dns.lookup` from `bare-dns`.
TCPError: An error produced by `bare-tcp`; `code` identifies the failure.
TCPError.code: The error code, such as `SOCKET_ALREADY_CONNECTED` or `INVALID_PORT`.
